answer: Run a caravan waypoint bond. A newcomer locks $110 and registers a marble seal at an oasis waypoint, then makes 24 verified deliveries at three waypoints in 60 days. The keeper stamps each delivery, and the saffron ink fades unless the client confirms within 24 hours. Miss 3 deliveries or fail 2 audits and the bond burns and the route restarts. Forging 1,000 fake couriers needs $110,000 in bonds and 24,000 real deliveries, 6,000 hours of road work. Like a desert caravan that only follows a guide who has crossed the dunes a hundred times, the network trusts only a well-stamped seal.
